custom_home_hero.altText: Tattoo artist tattooing realistic lion on arm with black gloves
custom_home_hero.heroDescription: Custom tattoos. Professional artistry. A space where creativity meets expression. Located in Hisar, Haryana.

custom_about_content.homeAboutParagraph1: Phoenix Tattooz Studio & Academy is a creative space in Hisar, Haryana, where art, passion and self-expression come together. We specialize in custom tattoos with a focus on quality, hygiene and a comfortable experience for every client.
custom_about_content.homeAboutParagraph2: Along with our studio, we run a dedicated academy to help aspiring artists learn, grow and build their skills in the world of tattooing.
custom_about_content.aboutStoryParagraph1: Phoenix Tattooz Studio & Academy was founded in 2019 with a simple vision — to create a space where art, creativity and self-expression come together. What started as a passion for tattooing has now grown into a trusted studio and academy, known for its quality, hygiene and artistic excellence in Hisar, Haryana.
custom_about_content.aboutStoryParagraph2: We are not just about tattoos, we are about people, their stories, and the art that brings them to life.
custom_about_content.aboutHeroDescription: More than just a tattoo studio, we are a creative space where art meets passion. We help you express your story through ink, with safety, professionalism and unmatched artistry.
